scripts.dev: echo Run npm.cmd run dev:api and npm.cmd run dev:web in separate terminals
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @aicp/shared && npm run dev -w @aicp/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @aicp/shared && npm run start:dev -w @aicp/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aicp/shared && npm run build -w @aicp/api && npm run build -w @aicp/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aicp/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:migrate: npm run prisma -w @aicp/api -- migrate dev --name init
